title.narrative: Programa de Rehabilitacin y Modernizacin de la Central Hidroelctrica Acaray
Rehabilitation and Modernization Program for the Acaray Hydropower Plant

description.narrative: El objetivo general del programa es contribuir a la modernizacin del sector elctrico de Paraguaya travs del financiamiento de inversiones de rehabilitacin de infraestructura elctrica de la Administracin Nacional deElectricidad (ANDE). El objetivo especfico es apoyar a la ANDE a rehabilitar y modernizar la Central Hidroelctrica Acaraypara contribuir a: (i) la extensin de su vida til; (ii) mejorar su disponibilidad y confiabilidad; y (iii) incrementar su capacidadde generacin.

The program's general objective is to help modernize Paraguay's electricity sector by financing investment to rehabilitate ANDE's electricity infrastructure. The specific objective is to assist ANDE in rehabilitating and modernizing the Acaray Hydroelectric Power Plant in order to: (i) extend its useful life; (ii) enhance its availability and reliability; and (iii) boost its generation capacity
